title: Pump Change over Procedure: (11-PM-01A to 11-PM-01B)
section_path: Chapter 16: Major equipment description and operating Procedure > 16.1 CRUDE CHARGE PUMP 11-PM-01A/B > Pump Change over Procedure

steps.text: Ensure the standby pump 11-PM-01B is lined up and the suction valve is open before starting.
Start the standby pump 11-PM-01B and check the discharge pressure on 11-PG-101.
Slowly open the discharge valve of 11-PM-01B while closing the discharge valve of 11-PM-01A. Caution: do not allow the flow to drop below the minimum flow of 219 m3/h.
Stop the running pump 11-PM-01A and inform the shift in-charge.

title: Heater light-off during normal start-up
section_path: Chapter 32: Standard Operating Procedures > 32.11 HEATER > Heater light-off during normal start-up

steps.text: Confirm the firebox of 11-F-01 has been purged with steam and the explosimeter reading is zero before light-off.
Ensure the fuel gas pressure is normal and the pilot gas line is lined up.
Light the pilot burner and observe the flame through the peephole.

title: Isolation of crude charge pump for maintenance
section_path: Chapter 32: Standard Operating Procedures > 32.5 PUMPS > Isolation of crude charge pump for maintenance

steps.text: Obtain a work permit from the shift in-charge before isolating the crude charge pump.
Close the suction and discharge valves of 11-PM-01A and depressurise the pump casing to the closed drain.
Blind the suction and discharge lines and hand over the pump to maintenance.
